    EFiniteCharacterizations.OrderedGroupSeries.exists_injective_boundary_of_biorder

    Division-ring coefficients from well-ordered series on a group #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.OrderedGroupSeries.exists_injective_boundary_of_biorder (k ι : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder (FreeGroup ι)] [MulLeftMono (FreeGroup ι)] [MulRightMono (FreeGroup ι)] :
    ∃ (D : Type u) (x : DivisionRing D) (x_1 : Algebra k D) (a : ι → D), Function.Injective ⇑(freeTensorBoundary k a)

    Well-ordered series on a biordered free group provide the division-ring coefficients needed for the generic copresentation. The algebra is realized by operators commuting with right convolution, so composition supplies its ring law and inverses are obtained by solving triangular equations.
